# Vendored googleapis protos

`google/api/annotations.proto` and `google/api/http.proto` — the HTTP mapping of a gRPC
method (`option (google.api.http)`), from which the REST encoding and the OpenAPI document
of the node contract are generated.

- Source: https://github.com/googleapis/googleapis, commit
  `2820f045329fc1d000570aee6a39226c3382b2e2` (fetched 2026-09-16).
- Licence: Apache-2.0, unchanged; the licence header is kept in each file.
- Never edited here. To update, fetch both files from one commit and change the SHA above
  in the same commit.
